tasks.short: Prepare and present executive reports on performance, finances and matters affecting the organisation.

steps.what: Set the report's audience, scope and decisions required.
Retrieve financial and operational figures for the reporting period.
Reconcile figures, resolve differences and assemble report tables.
Read legal and policy briefings for implications requiring executive attention.

loop.input: Approved legal briefings and policy documents within the report scope.
loop.output: Source-linked implications, open questions and effective dates.
loop.check: Require a source passage for each implication; flag uncertain applicability for qualified advice.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass; unresolved points return to the chief executive and legal adviser.
loop.why_not_simpler: Relevant obligations and qualifications appear in varied prose that fixed field mappings cannot reliably interpret.

steps.what: Draft the narrative, explanations, outlook and requested decisions.

loop.input: Report template, validated tables, source-linked implications and department updates.
loop.output: Draft executive report with source references and explicit gaps.
loop.check: Insert figures deterministically; verify cited figures and sources; label unsupported explanations and forecasts.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; incomplete sections remain flagged for human completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates produce tables, but explanations and audience-specific narrative require bounded language synthesis.

steps.what: Approve the report's claims, recommendations and release.
Present the approved report and answer stakeholder questions.

tasks.design: A scheduled integration on the {DATA_PLATFORM} retrieves figures from the {ERP} and {OPS_SYSTEM}, checks reconciliations and fills report tables in the {DOCS}. Bounded loops extract source-linked implications and draft the narrative; the chief executive approves release through the {WORKFLOW} and presents the report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Figures, explanations and legal briefings arrived separately. Preparing a coherent paper required repeated copying and executive editing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing connectors, templates and reconciliation rules handle the structured work. Bounded drafting can now use a controlled source pack, with figures checked separately.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining causes, judging legal applicability and making credible forward commitments remain demanding. Poor source data still requires investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The chief executive decides what the audience needs to know, accepts accountability and answers difficult questions.

ambition.what: A monthly downside-scenario briefing for the executive team.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less report assembly and more time testing assumptions before presentation. Formal approval rights stay unchanged; the chief executive can propose responses earlier within existing delegation.

reach.task: Prepare a cross-department operational risk briefing.
reach.learn: Operational metric definitions, capacity constraints and how to distinguish an observed variance from its suspected cause.

evidence.claim: Board Intelligence Report Writer drafts structured papers from management documents and flags missing forward-looking analysis.
Apex Group reported recovering 60% of report preparation time in a vendor case; this is not a forecast for this design.
Deterministic figure insertion and source-linked drafting are feasible, but savings depend on source quality and report complexity.

assumptions: Reports recur and reuse a recognisable structure.
The chief executive receives preparation support from the finance team.
Time shares cover active work across the listed contributors, excluding waiting time.
Build ranges describe a first reporting workflow with a limited source set, not an enterprise data rebuild.
unknowns: Which reports require board, legal adviser or regulator approval before release?
Which financial and operational sources have usable exports or interfaces?
How much source reconciliation already happens outside this task?
Which confidentiality restrictions and national consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Which report sections can be filled entirely from validated fields?
Can a historical report be reproduced with every figure and factual claim traceable to its source?
new_work: Review draft explanations, uncertainty flags and source references.
Resolve reconciliation exceptions before report release.
Maintain templates, metric mappings, access permissions and source currency.
Check GDPR requirements and applicable EU AI Act transparency duties for external public-interest text.

tasks.short: Implement corrective plans for organisational or departmental problems.

steps.what: Read the escalation, supporting evidence and previous attempts to resolve the problem.

loop.input: Escalation documents, supporting evidence and previous action records.
loop.output: Issue brief separating reported facts, disputed accounts, previous actions and unanswered questions.
loop.check: Attach source passages; preserve disagreements; prohibit inferred employee motives or unsupported blame.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass; missing or conflicting evidence goes to the responsible manager.
loop.why_not_simpler: Escalations contain varied narratives and conflicting accounts that structured fields alone cannot summarise.

steps.what: Discuss causes, constraints and affected interests with responsible managers and people involved.
Approve corrective actions, owners, resources, milestones and success measures.
Enter the approved plan into the action tracker and assign agreed owners.
Lead operational changes and resolve resistance or unexpected constraints.
Chase overdue milestones and collect progress evidence from action owners.
Evaluate results and decide whether to close, revise or escalate the plan.

tasks.design: A bounded loop prepares a source-linked issue brief from the {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. The chief executive records approved actions in a structured {WORKFLOW} form, which creates the plan in the {PROJECT}, schedules reminders and supplies progress views in the {BI}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans depended on negotiation and local context, while their administration sat in separate notes, messages and trackers.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing action-tracking configuration can handle ownership, deadlines and escalation. A small reading loop can reduce preparation without deciding remedies.
tasks.still_hard: Establishing causes, rebuilding trust and judging whether an intervention worked remain human work. Evidence of improvement may arrive late or be contested.
tasks.human_edge: The chief executive accepts responsibility for difficult trade-offs and secures cooperation when interests conflict.

ambition.what: Fortnightly stop-or-adapt decisions for corrective programmes.

tasks.altitude: The chief executive spends less time reconstructing the issue and chasing progress, and more time removing implementation barriers. Formal authority stays unchanged; earlier evidence supports earlier intervention.

reach.task: Design a limited operational pilot before committing to a corrective rollout.
reach.learn: Pilot design, baseline selection, operational dependencies and measures that reveal unintended effects.

evidence.claim: Structured action records, reminders and escalation rules can be configured without autonomous agents.
The digest's deterministic-first assessment keeps corrective judgement human while opening preparation and administration to automation.
GDPR Article 22 restricts qualifying solely automated decisions about individuals; this design retains human decisions.

assumptions: The task concerns organisational corrective plans; individual disciplinary procedures require a separate process.
Approved actions can be captured in structured fields during the approval step.
Time shares cover active work across contributors, excluding elapsed implementation time.
Build ranges include an initial consultation assessment; required national procedures may extend elapsed rollout.
unknowns: Which corrective actions require board approval or employee consultation under national rules?
Which existing action tracker supports structured approvals and reminders?
Who verifies implementation evidence and closes disputed actions?
Will issue briefs contain employee, health or other sensitive personal data?
research_questions: Which delays come from chasing information rather than unresolved management decisions?
Can success measures distinguish real improvement from task completion?
new_work: Review issue briefs for omitted disagreements and unsupported causal claims.
Handle unassigned actions, failed reminders and disputed completion evidence.
Maintain escalation thresholds, owner mappings and access restrictions.
Assess GDPR, EU AI Act and national consultation requirements if the scope extends into employee monitoring.

tasks.short: Evaluate operational and workforce results to choose cost, service and policy improvements.

steps.what: Retrieve financial, operational and aggregate workforce results against agreed objectives.
Reconcile definitions and calculate trends, variances and comparable departmental measures.
Inspect performance patterns and identify areas needing explanation.
Read managers' explanations, risks and proposed improvements.

loop.input: Department updates, performance questions and validated metric references.
loop.output: Review brief with proposed explanations, supporting evidence, disagreements and unanswered questions.
loop.check: Link statements to source passages; check referenced figures; distinguish hypotheses from demonstrated causes.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass; unsupported explanations remain questions for the review meeting.
loop.why_not_simpler: Manager explanations use varied prose; fixed thresholds cannot preserve their qualifications and disagreements.

steps.what: Challenge explanations and test improvement options with responsible managers.
Choose improvement priorities and approve investigations, pilots or policy proposals.
Record decisions, accountable owners and follow-up dates.

tasks.design: A governed dataset on the {DATA_PLATFORM} joins the {ERP}, {OPS_SYSTEM} and permitted aggregates from the {HCM}, with deterministic metric checks feeding the {BI}. A bounded loop prepares source-linked management explanations in the {DOCS}; executives test causes and approve priorities, then record follow-up in the {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Departments used different definitions and reporting periods. Executive analysis mixed data repair with interpretation and debate.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable metric models and configured dashboards can expose exceptions quickly. A bounded reading loop can organise commentary without treating it as proven causation.
tasks.still_hard: Comparable measures do not establish causes. Service quality, workload, market changes and local constraints can make apparent savings misleading.
tasks.human_edge: The chief executive weighs competing objectives, challenges convenient explanations and accepts the consequences of resource choices.

ambition.what: Weekly selection of a capacity or service-improvement pilot.

tasks.altitude: The chief executive moves from periodic retrospective review toward frequent testing of operational hypotheses. Formal decision rights stay unchanged; managers receive clearer boundaries for approved pilots.

reach.task: Evaluate whether an operational pilot produced a useful improvement.
reach.learn: Process variation, comparison groups, service safeguards and the difference between correlation and causation.

evidence.claim: Copilot in Power BI summarises reports and answers data questions; prepared data models remain important for accuracy.
Pigment offers anomaly flagging and report generation for business planning.
AI used for staff performance monitoring may fall within the EU AI Act's high-risk employment category, depending on intended purpose.
Rule-based metrics and aggregate dashboards can support executive analysis without automated individual performance judgements.

assumptions: The first version uses business measures and permitted workforce aggregates, without scoring individual employees.
The business analyst represents an existing finance or operations analysis role.
Time shares cover active work across contributors.
The reporting dataset can be shared with executive reporting; overlapping foundations should be budgeted once.
unknowns: Which objectives and metric definitions are agreed across departments?
Which workforce aggregates are permitted, and what group sizes protect confidentiality?
Does the intended use include individual performance evaluation or employee monitoring?
Which access approvals and employee consultation procedures apply under national rules?
research_questions: Which exceptions should use fixed thresholds, and which require contextual investigation?
Can historical figures be reconciled across finance and operations before introducing narrative summaries?
What evidence would justify changing policy rather than running a limited pilot?
new_work: Maintain metric definitions, comparability rules and data-quality checks.
Review commentary for unsupported causes or omitted counterevidence.
Investigate exceptions and assess pilot outcomes.
Maintain GDPR controls and assess EU AI Act and national consultation obligations if workforce analysis expands.

tasks.short: Coordinate departmental priorities, operating commitments and exceptions across production, pricing, sales and distribution.

steps.what: Submit departmental priorities, constraints and decisions requiring executive attention.
Review demand, capacity, margins and delivery commitments before coordination discussions.
Align managers on conflicting priorities, dependencies and feasible operating choices.
Approve priorities, resource trade-offs and exceptions within delegated authority.
Translate approved decisions into departmental assignments, dependencies and due dates.
Confirm departmental commitments and resolve practical handover questions.
Chase unresolved dependencies and escalate missed commitments.

tasks.design: Configure structured departmental updates and decision records in the {PROJECT}, with a shared operating view in the {BI}. Approved decisions populate assignments through the {WORKFLOW}; dependency checks and reminders surface exceptions while managers retain coordination and commitment conversations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Executive decisions were recorded inconsistently, and departments maintained separate plans. Follow-through depended on manual translation and chasing.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured records, dependency rules and existing approval configuration can connect decisions to departmental plans. Faster implementation makes a narrowly scoped coordination workflow practical without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Priorities change with customers, capacity and external events. Software cannot secure commitment or settle politically difficult resource conflicts.
tasks.human_edge: The chief executive resolves conflicts across departmental goals and creates credible shared commitments.

ambition.what: A weekly cross-department capacity reallocation decision.

tasks.altitude: The week contains fewer status requests and fewer ambiguous handovers. Formal authority stays unchanged; clearer exception boundaries let departmental managers act sooner within existing delegation.

reach.task: Coordinate a joint demand-and-capacity review across sales and delivery.
reach.learn: Capacity planning, commercial commitments, margin constraints and the effects of changing one department's priorities.

evidence.claim: Configured work records, dependency checks and reminders can support coordination without autonomous decision-making.
Copilot in Power BI demonstrates report summarisation and data questioning, but the proposed shared operating view can use deterministic dashboards.
The digest supports keeping direction and approvals human while automating their supporting records and monitoring.

assumptions: Department managers perform routine execution; this task covers executive coordination and follow-through.
Approved decision records specify owners and boundaries before assignments are propagated.
The existing performance dataset can support the operating view.
The first version tracks departmental commitments rather than individual employee behaviour.
Time shares cover active work across contributors; shared reporting foundations are budgeted once.
unknowns: Which operating decisions are reserved for the board or delegated to department managers?
Which plans and commitments already exist in the {PROJECT}?
Which assignment rules are explicit enough to configure?
Does implementation change employee scheduling or monitoring in ways requiring consultation under national rules?
research_questions: Which coordination meetings exist mainly to exchange status that a shared view could supply?
Which exceptions genuinely require the chief executive, and which belong with the general and operations manager?
Can approved decisions populate work plans without changing commercial commitments or publishing prices?
new_work: Maintain decision fields, dependency mappings and escalation thresholds.
Review conflicting assignments and unresolved ownership exceptions.
Remove stale priorities and check that propagated plans reflect approved decisions.
Maintain access controls and assess GDPR, EU AI Act and national consultation requirements if employee-level functionality is introduced.

role.altitude: The chief executive spends less time assembling evidence and chasing commitments, and more time testing assumptions, resolving conflicts and judging results. Board accountability and formal decision rights remain unchanged.
reach: Work with the general and operations manager to design bounded operational pilots.
Join demand-and-capacity planning with commercial and delivery managers.
Turn reporting evidence into earlier decisions on corrective investment and operating priorities.
skills_to_grow: Source checking and critical review of generated narratives.
Causal reasoning and operational pilot design.
Clear delegation, exception thresholds and structured decision records.
GDPR, EU AI Act and applicable national consultation requirements.
role.ambitious_version: Run a monthly operational resilience review that combines validated performance, downside scenarios and pilot evidence, producing explicit stop, adapt or invest decisions within board-approved authority.
